title: Obvara Firing Workshop
source_quote: Join us at Pottery Northwest for a very special Obvara firing! During this workshop participants will learn about how to prepare the obvara mixture and then be able to spectate while staff pulls the work from a preheated kiln and places them into a yeasty liquid mixture.
evidence_sentence: An Obvara firing workshop teaches participants to prepare the obvara mixture and spectate while staff pulls work from a kiln and places it into the liquid mixture.
evidence_quote: Join us at Pottery Northwest for a very special Obvara firing! During this workshop participants will learn about how to prepare the obvara mixture and then be able to spectate while staff pulls the work from a preheated kiln and places them into a yeasty liquid mixture.
summary: A workshop where participants learn the Obvara finishing process, an Eastern European technique that involves scalding the surface of fired pottery.
